core_claims.name: SynthTerm / CheckTerm / Synth / Check
core_claims.scope: Two mutually defined scoped syntaxes and bidirectional judgements for functions, naturals, case, general fixpoints, annotations and mode switches, in arbitrary matching context vectors.

core_claims.name: typeEqual / synthUnique
core_claims.scope: Decidable structural equality of simple types and uniqueness of synthesis for the same annotated/scoped term in the same context. No uniqueness or principal-type claim for raw terms.

core_claims.name: synthesize
core_claims.scope: Total Dec (a : Ty ** Synth gamma t a) for every scoped synthesis input; every No branch constructs a refutation of all possible result types/derivations.

core_claims.name: check
core_claims.scope: Total Dec (Check gamma t a) for every scoped checking input and expected type; rejected embeddings and applications use synthesis uniqueness to exclude alternative derivations.

core_claims.name: synthSound / checkSound
core_claims.scope: Every bidirectional derivation yields an external HasType derivation for the annotation/mode-erased raw term.

core_claims.name: elaborateSynth / elaborateCheck / synthErasure / checkErasure
core_claims.scope: Every successful derivation yields an intrinsic term with the same context/type, whose forgotten raw syntax equals direct erasure of the annotated input.

core_claims.name: synthesizeComplete / checkComplete
core_claims.scope: Existence of a derivation of the queried bidirectional judgement implies the corresponding algorithm returns a Yes result. Completeness is relative to the annotated judgement, not arbitrary typability of erased raw input.

core_claims.name: inferredTermCorrect / inferredComputed
core_claims.scope: The inferred/elaborated plus-two-two term equals the earlier intrinsic addition application; evaluation of that inferred term yields Just 4.

core_claims.name: identityAt / badApplicationImpossible / annotationRejected / erasureStillTyped
core_claims.scope: Identity checks at any a->a; annotated zero application has no synthesis type; a wrong arrow annotation is rejected although its erased zero remains typable.

exercises.scope: Check identity at any requested simple type and in any context without contradicting synthesis uniqueness.
Refute all synthesis result types for applying annotated natural zero and check algorithmic rejection.
Reject a wrong annotation while proving the erased program typable, delimiting completeness.

deviations: Named lookup is replaced by Fin-scoped variables and a matching Vect context; input scope/name resolution is outside this interface, not an omitted type-error branch.
The checking procedure is named check rather than upstream inherit.
SyApp retains its domain type and ChEmbed its synthesized type as computational implicit arguments so No proofs can reconstruct existential type/derivation packages in Idris.
Elaboration factors through proved external soundness and the DeBruijn correspondence, with explicit erasure equations.
Optional inference extensions for products and the rest of More are not implemented or claimed; the complete core functions/naturals/case/fix bidirectional language is decided.
